## Visibility Metrics to Track

### **GitHub Insights**

- Repository traffic (views, unique visitors)
- Popular content (which files get viewed most)
- Referral sources (where traffic comes from)
- Clone activity

### **External Metrics**

- LinkedIn profile views after sharing
- X/Twitter engagement on posts
- Google Search Console (if hosting docs site)
- Backlinks from other sites/repos

### **Professional Network**

- Connection requests mentioning repository
- Job inquiries referencing specific content
- Community discussions citing your work
